estate.title: Our story
estate.intro: A lifelong wine enthusiast, I took over a ten-hectare wine estate in Anjou toward the end of my career, after working in a different field. Guided by quality, I am learning this demanding craft with humility, as part of a shared adventure with people and nature.
estate.story_title: A change of life inspired by a passion
estate.story: After a career in a completely different field, I decided to pursue a project I had long dreamed of: becoming a winegrower. Driven by a lasting passion for wine, I wanted to understand and experience the whole winemaking process, from vine to bottle. Giving myself to it fully, physically and emotionally, felt like a natural choice.

michel.bio: Come wind, rain or snow, Michel is always out working in the vines. Between showers, you may find him walking his dog Rika through the vineyard.

christophe.bio: With over 35 years at a renowned Loire estate, Christophe always has something to share. You may find him inside a vat or among the rows of vines.

tanguy.bio: Studying business at the École supérieure des agricultures in Angers as part of a work-study program, Tanguy can introduce you to the different wines. You may find him at the estate between university sessions.

wines.title: Our wines
wines.intro: Chenin and Grolleau: discover the estate's six wines.

anjou25.title: Anjou blanc sec 2025
anjou25.origin: Chenin grown on our oldest plot, “Rossignolerie”.
anjou25.notes: An aromatic nose with yellow peach notes. A fairly full palate with lime blossom aromas and a lovely acacia finish.

anjou24.title: Anjou blanc sec 2024
anjou24.origin: Chenin grown on our schist-rich terroir, which gives it its mineral character.
anjou24.notes: Aromas of white flowers, pastries and white peach. A structured palate with lovely tension, flinty notes and a light hint of mint.

rose25.title: Rosé de Loire sec 2025
rose25.origin: 100% Grolleau from a small, well-exposed hillside, giving a lovely pink hue and tangy fruit notes.
rose25.notes: A generous, rounded palate with a raspberry finish.

epure.title: White sparkling wine
epure.origin: L'Epure: a cuvée shaped by Chenin, like a carpenter shaping their work.
epure.notes: A lightly brioche-scented nose with green apple aromas. A fruit-led palate opening into notes of white flowers.

eclat.title: Rosé sparkling wine
eclat.origin: L'Eclat: a lively cuvée with a lovely hue from Grolleau and a hint of sweetness.
eclat.notes: Slightly tangy red berry aromas. A rounded, generous palate with a rose finish.

layon25.title: Coteaux du Layon 2025
layon25.origin: Chenin picked at peak ripeness from a vigorous, steep plot called Monts Pertus.
layon25.notes: Ripe fruit aromas, including mango and yellow apple. A gently sweet palate with lavender honey notes and a long finish.
